Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model

Record Class NewsletterRun

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.NewsletterRun
Record Components:
runId - Primary key — equals the draftId passed to generate().
title - Newsletter edition title (e.g. "AI in Healthcare Weekly").
weekOf - Publication date of the edition.
htmlContent - Full HTML email body, inline-styled, ready for rendering.
plainTextContent - Plain-text version with no HTML tags; suitable for a textarea.
status - Lifecycle status: DRAFT → SENT → ARCHIVED.
generatedAt - Timestamp when this run was generated.
public record NewsletterRun(String runId, String title, LocalDate weekOf, String htmlContent, String plainTextContent, NewsletterRunStatus status, Instant generatedAt) extends Record
Immutable domain record representing a persisted newsletter run.

A NewsletterRun is the permanent historical record of a newsletter that was generated (and eventually sent) for a given week. It stores both the HTML-formatted email content and the bare plain-text equivalent so that:

  • The subscriber archive web page can render the HTML in a styled <div> without re-generating it.
  • The plain-text version is available in a <textarea> for accessibility and copy-paste use.

The runId is the primary key stored in the newsletter_runs table and corresponds to the draftId supplied to GenerateNewsletterUseCase.generate(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.NewsletterTone, int, boolean, int).

Rendering from NewsletterDraft to HTML and plain text is performed by NewsletterRenderer in the application layer immediately after generation. This record is then saved via NewsletterRunPort.
